tables.name: master_declaration
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE master_declaration (
        source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES master_source(source_sha256),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>0),
        family TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(family IN ('datapoint_type','function_type','function_point','space_usage')),
        element TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(element IN ('DatapointType','DatapointSubtype','FunctionType','FunctionPoint','SpaceUsage')),
        logical_id TEXT, xml_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        byte_start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_start>=0),
        byte_end INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_end>byte_start),
        main_number INTEGER, function_type_id TEXT,
        missing_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(missing_id IN (0,1)),
        orphan_parent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(orphan_parent IN (0,1)),
        observed_write INTEGER CHECK(observed_write IN (0,1)),
        CHECK(missing_id=(logical_id IS NULL)),
        CHECK(observed_write IS NULL OR (missing_id=0 AND orphan_parent=0)),
        PRIMARY KEY(source_sha256,ordinal)
    )

        definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(definition_version=1),
        history TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(history IN ('observed','historical-unavailable')),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('complete','failed','unexamined')),
        reason TEXT,
        CHECK((status='complete')=(reason IS NULL))
    )

        FOREIGN KEY(source_sha256,ordinal) REFERENCES master_declaration(source_sha256,ordinal),

CREATE TABLE package_baggage_payload (
            package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES package_baggage_inventory(package_sha256),
            member_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            sha256 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_file(sha256),
            size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
            media_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (media_class IN ('empty','png','jpeg','gif','bmp','pdf','zip','pe-executable','ole2-compound','xml','unknown')),
            declarations INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (declarations >= 0),
            nested_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (nested_status IN ('not-archive','unreadable','read')),
            nested_entries INTEGER CHECK (nested_entries >= 0),
            nested_expanded_size INTEGER CHECK (nested_expanded_size >= 0),
            nested_encrypted_entries INTEGER CHECK (nested_encrypted_entries >= 0),
            nested_archive_names INTEGER CHECK (nested_archive_names >= 0),
            PRIMARY KEY (package_sha256, member_path),
            CHECK ((nested_status = 'read') = (nested_entries IS NOT NULL)),
            CHECK ((nested_entries IS NULL) = (nested_expanded_size IS NULL)),
            CHECK ((nested_entries IS NULL) = (nested_encrypted_entries IS NULL)),
            CHECK ((nested_entries IS NULL) = (nested_archive_names IS NULL)),
            CHECK ((media_class = 'zip') = (nested_status <> 'not-archive'))
        )
